text:
Type: black metal corner shelving unit
Use: displaying plants, books and small decor in a corner; living room, bedroom, bathroom
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: black powder-coated steel frame, quarter-round glass and perforated metal shelves
Colors: matte black, clear glass
Shape: tall slim triangular tower that fits a corner, vertical rods along the back, scrolled wrought-iron crest and finials on top, curved front edges, ball feet, light and see-through
Feel: romantic, vintage, airy, delicate
Goes with: white walls, pale wood, wicker, green plants; farmhouse, cottage or classic rooms
